text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, INR, and RDW, as well as low total protein. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and impaired oxygenation, which may be seen in severe infection (e.g., viral pneumonia/COVID-19) or sepsis. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are strongly recommended.
